generate_image_embeddings_from_prompt: generate image embeddings from a text prompt using the KandinskyV22PriorPipeline prior model
interpolate_image_embeddings: interpolate image embeddings from a mix of text prompts and images using the interpolate method
encode_prompt_with_clip: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the _encode_prompt method
prepare_latents_for_prior: prepare noisy latent tensors for the prior diffusion process using the prepare_latents method
get_zero_embedding: get a zero image embedding from the CLIP image encoder using the get_zero_embed method
